main.description: One moderation assertion per (actor, scope, subject, action key), in the actor's repo. Record key: {fk}-{h16("modAction", scope_eff, subject, actionKey)}; keys of the form {fk}-{tid} are reserved (P2) and ignored. Deleting the record removes the assertion. Updates and removals go through the revision protocol.

scope.description: Authority used: forum (owner, admin, moderator) or author (post author in their own thread). Absent means forum. An unknown value: no effect.

subject.description: Exactly one of: a did, a canonical at-uri, or "tag:" + slug. Allowed forms depend on the action.

subjectCid.description: CID of the subject version acted on. Required (core rule) for positive assertions: keep, tier frontpage or curated, pinned.

action.description: The action. An unknown $type has no effect and is shown as an unknown action.

until.description: The assertion lapses when until <= now.

adopts.description: The former moderator's modAction record re-issued by this record. Informational.

createdAt.description: Set once at creation by the writer's clock; never changed.

hide.description: Hide or keep an item. Key "hide". Subject: at-uri of a post, comment, sequence or wikiRevision. hidden=false (keep) is positive.

hidden.description: true hides; false keeps (overrides a ban or restriction for this item).

spam.description: Marks the item as spam. Ignored in author scope.

showReason.description: Whether the reason is shown with the placeholder.

access.description: Ban or grant membership. Key "access". Subject: a did.

level.description: banned or member. An unknown value: no effect.

restrict.description: Restrict capabilities, retroactively hiding in-forum items of each restricted kind. Key "restrict". Subject: a did. Forum scope only.

capabilities.description: Restricted capabilities; unknown items are ignored, duplicates collapse.

nullifyVotes.description: Discard all the user's votes in the forum.

tier.description: Set a post's tier. Key "tier". Subject: at-uri of a post. frontpage and curated are positive. Forum scope only.
Tier. An unknown value: no effect.

notice.description: Moderator notice shown on the post. Inline only.

pin.description: Pin an item. Key "pin:" + scope. Subject: a post or sequence (scope forum) or a comment (scope thread). pinned=true is positive.

scope.description: Where the item is pinned. An unknown value: no effect.

lock.description: Lock a post's thread. Key "lock". Subject: at-uri of a post (a forum at-uri is reserved, P2, and has no effect).

allowed.description: Comment at-uris that stay visible; entries outside the post's thread are ignored.

tag.description: Moderate a tag. Key "tag". Subject: "tag:" + slug. Forum scope only.

removed.description: Removes the tag from the forum.

head.description: The wikiRevision chosen as the tag page head.
